documents.FBIS_1: Cambodian political leaders gathered in Phnom Penh for a special summit. King Norodom Sihanouk urged rival parties to form a coalition government to stabilize the nation. Prime Minister Hun Sen stated his party is open to negotiations.
documents.FBIS_2: The opposition party leader Prince Norodom Ranariddh agreed to participate in talks. International observers reported the election was generally peaceful despite minor voting irregularities in rural provinces.
documents.APW_1: Talks on forming Cambodia's new government made preliminary progress on Monday. Both coalition partners pledged to respect the democratic constitution and restore economic stability.

reference_summaries: Cambodian political rivals met in Phnom Penh under King Norodom Sihanouk to negotiate a coalition government following recent national elections. Leaders Hun Sen and Prince Ranariddh agreed to constitutional talks to restore political stability.
